name: 浴血江湖
group_note: 浴血江湖3梦回江湖. WASM pass found and fixed 5 genuine bugs: (1) the plain-named adm/etc/preload file was MISSING from the archive (only preload.bak and a slightly-shorter preloadbb variant existed) -- restored it from preload.bak (the more complete of the two), which also turned out to have CRLF line endings that update_file()'s explode(str,"\n") doesn't strip, so every preloaded daemon path was silently becoming e.g. '/adm/daemons/securityd\r.lpc' and failing file_size() -- converted to LF so preload actually works (previously ZERO daemons were being preloaded; logind.lpc only worked by accident via direct inheritance from clone/user/login.lpc). (2) Standard §8.1 GBK byte-range check_legal_name() (i%2==0 parity gate, name[i..<0] suffix slice, byte-doubled 2/10 bounds) in the one ACTIVE adm/daemons/logind.lpc, fixed to per-codepoint name[i..i] and 1/5 bounds; is_chinese() itself was already correct. Left three dead backup copies untouched (clone/user/logind.lpc sits alongside the real clone/user/login.lpc plus login_back.lpc/loginbak.lpc; u/rock/ is a wizard's personal full-mudlib backup directory with its own logind.lpc/master.lpc/user.lpc/etc.) -- neither LOGIN_D nor the master file config point at either, confirmed via master file/simulated efun file paths in config.fluffos. (3) master.lpc's valid_read()/valid_write() (the real adm/obj/master.lpc, not u/rock/obj/master.lpc's dead copy) were missing the standard 'user == this_object()' short-circuit -- added to both. (4) d/jerry/saveme.lpc's create() called exert_function(10) -- exert_function(string func) (defined in inherit/char/npc.lpc) takes a skill-name string, not an int, so this NPC failed to compile at all ('*No program in object'), breaking a chunk of a city room's population every boot; the call's intent is unrecoverable (dead code, not miskeyed arithmetic like other libs' fixes this session) so it was simply removed, matching how yhyxcs's earlier native-boot pass deleted an unrecoverable force-reload trick rather than guess at a fix. (5) 118 of 130 .o save files under data/ were CRLF, which the driver's restore_object() can choke on for nested-mapping structures -- normalized all to LF; this fixed most but not all restore issues (see below). Socket-touching adm/daemons/httpd.lpc and adm/daemons/network/dns_master.lpc are both absent from the (now-restored) preload list and have no real external callers -- left untouched, no §7.52 gutting needed. Admin seeded: fluffos (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist (this lib's tier ladder tops out at (ceo) above (admin); used the project-standard (admin) tier for consistency, per this session's convention). Registration verified end-to-end pre- and post-formatter (English id -> y confirm -> Chinese name -> admin password + confirm -> login password + confirm -> gift-stat menu ('0' random -> 'y' accept) -> email -> gender -> enters 中央广场), admin permission confirmed via '◇ 您目前权限：(admin)'. Known NOT-fixed issue: adm/daemons/named.lpc's restore_object() still throws 'Illegal mapping format while restoring dbase' at every boot even after the CRLF fix -- the save file's mapping literal is syntactically balanced (verified bracket-matched) so the cause is something else in this driver's stricter restore_object() parser, not chased down further; the failure is caught (preload()'s catch()) and only degrades named.lpc's near-name-collision dedup checking, it does not block registration, world entry, or any other observed functionality -- logged per AGENTS.md §7.15's spirit, not blocking. LPC formatter run across all 13038 .lpc files (11874 written, 1119 pre-existing unterminated-string/textblock errors on this session's messiest codebase left unformatted, 45 unchanged). No :: parent-call split hits, no case-label-with-trailing-comment candidates, no CJK-respacing/broken-escape hits. Post-formatter re-verified with the same full registration+admin-login flow -- clean, admin permission still (admin).
